item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 47505de5153f5c0319ec3ca5a81a71b6dd37b10f and b82acf5170ff68e57af100d608d31c62ec88428c, changed_paths the two landed files, landing line quoting 3F/4P EXIT=1 at base and 7P EXIT=0 at head, baseline_suite 0 failures and after_suite 0 failures — but after_suite's log_path is "/home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon-placeholder" (manifest.md:17), a path that does not exist, while the readable run is after-suite-final.log in the same directory.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node declared reckon, tests, docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround[,/qwnw-red-file-session-lives-on-its-run.html] and docs/figures/...; git diff --stat 6fa2b177c511a297d3440956aa64eaa759d4554a..b82acf5170ff lists exactly tests/test_session_lives_on_its_run.py (+24 -7) and docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-red-file-session-lives-on-its-run.html (+95), both inside that fence.

justifications.durability: the version half of tests/test_session_lives_on_its_run.py:139-145 is falsified by the recorded mutation arm (mutation-roster-write.log: reassigning crew.observe to rewrite the roster through ledger.write_members reddens 3 of 3 roster cases with members bytes identical and only the version advanced), and the base arm's FileNotFoundError shows the repaired read is the line the old defect hit.
justifications.evidence: the measure is recorded and re-readable — job-node-measure.out:1 names job 1328988 on all_debug, node-measure-base.log and node-measure-head.log carry the FileNotFoundError reproduction and the green run, and both suite arms read "58 passed" — but manifest.md:17 names a non-existent log_path ("/home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon-placeholder") for after_suite and manifest.md:12 records the importer-file arm rather than the node's own file as `tests:`.
justifications.fit: the added `_status` helper at tests/test_session_lives_on_its_run.py:147-155 follows the per-file `_git(...)` subprocess idiom of tests/test_a_commit_that_fails_to_resolve_refuses_the_promotion.py:46 rather than a shared helper, and the docstrings name the mechanism without a plan or ticket id.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_session_lives_on_its_run.py:131-172 now reads and seeds the roster through reckon/ledger.py:2606 load_auxiliary and :2638 write_members, and node-measure-head.log reads "7 passed ... EXIT=0" at 47505de515, so the file passes in full.
justifications.reuse: the roster read and seed call the existing owners reckon/ledger.py:2606 load_auxiliary and :2638 write_members instead of forking a reader, and the shell-out helper duplicates only the conventional per-file `_git` shape (searched tests/ and tests/conftest.py: no shared git owner exists).
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 6fa2b177c5..b82acf5170 lists only tests/test_session_lives_on_its_run.py and docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-red-file-session-lives-on-its-run.html, both inside the declared write paths.
